description: LOCAL run mode: run the 14 Python app services as host uvicorn processes (distinct ports via the uvicorn --port CLI arg) with infra staying in Docker (make up-infra), and the React UI (from FEAT-001) via the Vite dev server on 5173 pointed at local checkout-api, orchestrated by start-local.sh/stop-local.sh + Makefile up-local/down-local + a committed .env.local.example, plus .gitignore and local-mode docs. The existing all-Docker path (./start.sh, make up, existing compose blocks, .env.example) stays byte-for-byte unchanged — this feature adds NO backend code and NO compose service edits (redpanda already advertises localhost:19092). Depends on FEAT-001 (references the ui/ Vite dev server) so runs second.
steps: Create .env.local.example (committed) with a header comment that infra stays in Docker (make up-infra), the 14 app services run as host processes, and the React UI runs via `npm run dev` on 5173. Set KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP=localhost:19092, NEO4J_URI=bolt://localhost:7687, POSTGRES_DSN=postgresql://acip:acip@localhost:5432/acip, REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379/0, and each *_URL -> http://localhost:<port> per the port map: ORCHESTRATOR_URL 8081, REPRESENTATION_URL 8082, ML_SCORING_URL 8083, LLM_GATEWAY_URL 8084, DECISION_ENGINE_URL 8085, PAYMENT_PROCESSOR_URL 8086. Keep the non-URL config (thresholds, LLM mock, POLICY_*, etc.) the same as .env.example. Do NOT modify .env.example.

Create start-local.sh (executable, `set -euo pipefail`, cd to its own dir): header note; prereq + docker-daemon checks (reuse start.sh style) PLUS a node/npm presence check that fails with a clear 'install Node 20' message; `make up-infra`; wait for container health of acip-redpanda/acip-neo4j/acip-postgres/acip-redis (reuse start.sh's wait_for_container_health helper pattern); train models if ml/models/model_card.json missing; `cp .env.local.example .env.local` if absent; export host DSNs (POSTGRES_DSN/NEO4J_URI/REDIS_URL) from .env.local and run scripts/seed.py; launch all 14 app services as background processes from a service->(module,port) table — `uv run uvicorn <module>.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port <N>` with env from .env.local, stdout/stderr to logs/<svc>.log, PID to run/<svc>.pid — using the map checkout_api:8080, commerce_orchestrator:8081, representation_service:8082, ml_scoring_service:8083, llm_gateway:8084, decision_engine:8085, payment_processor_sim:8086, risk_agent:8091, fraud_agent:8092, routing_agent:8093, policy_agent:8094, merchant_agent:8095, checkout_personalization_agent:8096, graph_projector:8097; wait for http://localhost:8080/healthz; start the React Vite dev server (cd ui && [npm ci if node_modules missing] && VITE_CHECKOUT_API_URL=http://localhost:8080 npm run dev -- --port 5173) as a tracked background process (logs/ui.log, run/ui.pid); run `CHECKOUT_URL=http://localhost:8080 uv run python scripts/demo.py`; print a URL summary with the UI at http://localhost:5173 first, checkout-api at :8080, how to tail logs (tail -f logs/*.log), how to stop (./stop-local.sh). mkdir -p logs run early.

Create stop-local.sh (executable, `set -euo pipefail`, cd to its own dir): kill tracked host PIDs from run/*.pid (SIGTERM, verify gone, remove stale pid files) INCLUDING the Vite dev server (run/ui.pid); flags: default LEAVES infra up; --all runs `docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml stop` of infra; -v runs `docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml down -v` (wipe volumes); -h prints usage; unknown arg -> error exit 2. Print exactly what it did; running with no pid files is a clean no-op.

Add Makefile targets up-local (runs ./start-local.sh) and down-local (runs ./stop-local.sh; document that args pass through) with `## ` help strings, and add both to .PHONY. `make up-infra` already exists and is reused.
Append to .gitignore: logs/, run/, .env.local, ui/node_modules/, ui/dist/.

Add a 'Run locally (host processes)' section to README.md and docs/DEMO-WALKTHROUGH.md: prerequisites (incl. Node 20), `make up-local`/`make down-local`, the note that infra stays in Docker and Docker-mode ./start.sh is unchanged, the host port map, UI at :5173 (local) vs :8090 (Docker), how to view logs/stop. Do NOT modify docs/01-07. Then stage source files and commit locally on feat/phase1-foundation with a short -m one-liner (e.g. 'feat(local): host-process local run mode + start/stop scripts'); never commit .env.local/logs/run; never push. Record in findings whether the live local-mode run (Vite dev server + demo.py) was executed or skipped (e.g. host Node unavailable).
acceptance_criteria: `.env.local.example` is committed and contains localhost overrides including KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP=localhost:19092 and every *_URL -> http://localhost:<assigned-port> per the port map; .env.example is unchanged.

`bash -n start-local.sh` and `bash -n stop-local.sh` parse; both are executable; the start-local service->port table matches the port map (checkout 8080, orchestrator 8081, representation 8082, ml-scoring 8083, llm-gateway 8084, decision-engine 8085, payment-sim 8086, agents+graph-projector 8091-8097) and launches the Vite dev server on 5173.
stop-local.sh with no pid files is a clean no-op; --all/-v tear down infra/volumes; default leaves infra up.
`make help` lists up-local and down-local; `make -n up-local` shows ./start-local.sh.
.gitignore excludes logs/, run/, .env.local, ui/node_modules/, ui/dist/ (confirmed by `git status --porcelain` showing none of them untracked after a run).

The all-Docker path is unchanged: start.sh behavior (apart from the FEAT-001 summary line), make up, existing compose service blocks, and .env.example are untouched by this feature; no backend code and no compose service edits were made here.
README.md and docs/DEMO-WALKTHROUGH.md document local mode with the port map and the UI at :5173 (local) vs :8090 (Docker); docs/01-07 unchanged.

cd /Users/rahulurane/Documents/git_repo/agentic-commerce-intelligence-platform && git check-ignore logs run .env.local ui/node_modules ui/dist >/dev/null && echo gitignore-ok

findings: Implemented LOCAL host-process run mode additively. New files: .env.local.example (committed; KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP=localhost:19092, every store + *_URL pointed at localhost per the port map; ML_MODELS_DIR set to the host-relative ml/models so the ml-scoring host process loads the same trained artifacts as Docker rather than silently degrading to the heuristic), start-local.sh + stop-local.sh (both set -euo pipefail, executable, cd to own dir, reuse start.sh's say/warn/die + wait_for_container_health patterns). start-local checks docker/compose/uv AND node/npm (fails with a clear 'install Node 20' message when missing), runs make up-infra, waits for acip-redpanda/neo4j/postgres/redis health, trains models if absent, cp .env.local.example->.env.local if absent, seeds with host DSNs, launches the 14 services as background `uv run uvicorn <module>.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port <N>` with env sourced from .env.local (logs/<svc>.log, run/<svc>.pid) using the exact map checkout_api:8080, commerce_orchestrator:8081, representation_service:8082, ml_scoring_service:8083, llm_gateway:8084, decision_engine:8085, payment_processor_sim:8086, risk_agent:8091, fraud_agent:8092, routing_agent:8093, policy_agent:8094, merchant_agent:8095, checkout_personalization_agent:8096, graph_projector:8097; waits for checkout-api /healthz; starts the Vite dev server (cd ui, npm ci if node_modules missing, VITE_CHECKOUT_API_URL=http://localhost:8080 npm run dev -- --port 5173; logs/ui.log, run/ui.pid); runs CHECKOUT_URL=http://localhost:8080 scripts/demo.py; prints a URL summary (UI :5173 first). stop-local kills tracked run/*.pid (SIGTERM + verify-gone + remove stale pid files, incl. run/ui.pid), default leaves infra up, --all -> compose stop, -v -> compose down -v, -h usage, unknown arg -> exit 2, no pid files -> clean no-op. Makefile: added up-local (./start-local.sh) + down-local (./stop-local.sh with ARGS passthrough), both in .PHONY, with ## help; added a local-mode line to the help footer. .gitignore: appended .env.local, logs/, run/, ui/node_modules/, ui/dist/. Docs: added a 'Run locally (host processes)' section to README.md and an equivalent alternative section to docs/DEMO-WALKTHROUGH.md (prereqs incl. Node 20, make up-local/down-local, host port map, UI :5173 local vs :8090 Docker, logs/stop). All-Docker path kept byte-for-byte: no backend code, no compose service edits, .env.example and docs/01-07 untouched (git diff confirms only .gitignore/Makefile/README.md/docs/DEMO-WALKTHROUGH.md changed). LIVE LOCAL RUN: EXECUTED (host had Node v20.20.2 + npm 10.8.2 + uv + docker, contrary to the context.json note that node/npm were absent). `make up-local` brought infra up in Docker, launched all 14 host services, started the Vite dev server, and scripts/demo.py passed all five scenarios vs http://localhost:8080 (clean_shopper->APPROVE, ring_member->DECLINE, high_value_midrisk->CHALLENGE, sanctioned_geo->DECLINE, unhealthy_preferred_route->APPROVE); the UI served HTTP 200 on http://localhost:5173 (title 'ACIP — Demo UI'). Then ./stop-local.sh -v stopped all 14 host processes and tore down infra + volumes cleanly (exit 0). Static gate also green: bash -n both scripts, executable bits, .env.local.example grep, make -n up-local/down-local, make help lists both, git check-ignore matches logs/ run/ .env.local ui/node_modules ui/dist. git status --porcelain shows none of .env.local/logs/run untracked (all gitignored).
